topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't stop thinking about how the room changed when you told me. One minute, we were in the kitchen, and the next, it felt like a whole new space, even though nothing physically shifted. You spoke about the move so calmly, like you were explaining the direction of the clouds, but everything around us seemed different. I poured us both another cup of coffee, but it tasted strange, not quite like coffee anymore. I asked if you wanted to add sugar, but my voice sounded off, like it was coming from far away. I nodded as you talked about new beginnings, but my mind kept wandering back to all the places we’d been, the rooms we filled with our voices, now echoing with silence.
